thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALARM: inference-runtime (cluster: prod-gpu) reported repeated CUDA OOMs on node gpu-12. Headroom telemetry shows ~3.8 GiB free but allocator failures observed. Triggered by heavy long-context customer jobs.

evan_oncall: seeing the alert, pulling up node metrics now. any immediate customer impact?

incident-bot: Recent 1m error-rate spike: +3.1%  (500s / truncated responses). Affected pods: inference-runtime-v2-[4,6,7]. Pod restart loop detected on gpu-12.

maria_infra: attaching top-level logs, looks like allocator failed to reserve a contiguous block even though headroom present — fragmentation / reserved-block mismatch likely.

maria_infra: ```
[2026-03-15T10:07:12Z] cuda:error: out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB
allocator: tried reserved span=1.5 GiB, free segments fragmented: [512MiB, 384MiB, 256MiB, 640MiB]
kv-cache: holding 3.1 GiB pinned
spare_pool: 1.0 GiB avail
```

evan_oncall: that log lines up with fragmentation — individual free segments too small for the contiguous allocation. KV-cache pinned large prefixes. can we release KV cache for these pods?

maria_infra: trying eviction endpoint for kv-cache on those pods: /diagnostics/kvcache/evict?scope=prefix-heavy. Sending now.

anu_ops: temporarily disable prefetch for the inference pods on gpu-12 to reduce speculative allocations. applying patch to k8s deployment (prefetch.enabled=false)

kevin_sre: i've increased node spare_pool target by 1.5 GiB via runtime config to create larger contiguous slabs (hot patch). will monitor.

liz_custsuccess: FYI customer-visible: a handful of sessions reported truncated completions and a few requests failed. I'll start a short incident banner for affected customers /workflows.

incident-bot: action log: kv-cache eviction request sent (3 pods), prefetch toggle applied, spare_pool bumped. Watch window 5m.

maria_infra: eviction responses: pods accepted evict, reclaimed ~2.6 GiB across the three pods. However allocator still failing for ~1 allocation per minute — fragmentation lingered.

evan_oncall: spinning a replacement node and migrating 3 pods off gpu-12 to other healthy nodes as a mitig. kubectl cordon+drain in progress.

kevin_sre: migration started. note: one of the pods hit a container crash during restart with crashloop backoff due to a liveness check timing out after GC pause. increasing liveness probe timeout temporarily.

maria_infra: dug into allocator telemetry: reserved block accounting off by ~200 MiB (double-count on reserve fastpath) for this node's runtime process. that explains why headroom metric is optimistic. filing an issue for the allocator counter mismatch.

maria_infra: allocator diagnostic summary: fragmentation high (avg free-seg-size 420MiB), reserved_claims=1.2GiB, accounted_headroom=3.8GiB, effective_contiguous=~900MiB.

evan_oncall: customer impact summary: error spike window 10:06–10:12 UTC, ~180 failed/truncated requests (0.9% of cluster qps), top customers: partner-A long-context job, internal load tests. Liz pls escalate for partner-A if SLA risk.

liz_custsuccess: on it — opening an incident banner: "We’re investigating intermittent failures/short truncations for long-context generation jobs. Mitigation underway." i'll coordinate postmortem notes with ops.

kevin_sre: mitigation status: node drained, 3 pods rescheduled off gpu-12, kv-cache eviction completed, prefetch disabled. error-rate dropping to baseline. still watching allocator counter fix.

incident-bot: system note: autoscaler suppressed scaling due to reserved policy; manual intervention recommended if pressure continues.

maria_infra: short term followups: 1) revert prefetch toggle only after verifying stable memory. 2) patch allocator reserve accounting to fix double-count (will prepare hotfix PR). 3) add an evasive contiguous-allocation path (best-effort merge of smaller segments) as a medium-term improvement.

evan_oncall: handing off to kevin_sre for the overnight watch and allocator fix coordination. I'll update runbook and add links to telemetry dashboards.

kevin_sre: taking over. I'll keep the temporary config (prefetch off, spare_pool +1.5GiB, liveness timeout bumped) and validate the allocator fix tomorrow morning. If we see >0.5% error rate again, escalate to infra-eng.

liz_custsuccess: post-incident communications: drafting a short note to partner-A and affected customers summarizing impact, mitigation, and next steps (root cause: allocator fragmentation + misaccounted reserves).

incident-bot: incident timeline checkpoint logged. Please add your investigation notes and tag with #postmortem.

kevin_sre: acknowledged. leaving a short checklist in the thread: [ ] confirm allocator counter bug in prod binaries [ ] merge hotfix PR + canary [ ] smoke test long-context workloads [ ] revert prefetch toggle once stable

maria_infra: saved diagnostic bundle to /artifacts/incident-3627770000/ (alloc-traces, kvcache-stats, node-metrics). linking in the postmortem doc.

kevin_sre: nightly owner assigned. ping me if any regression. leaving handoff: next_oncall := @kevin_sre.

evan_oncall: thanks all. closing active mitigation loop. I'll include reproduction steps in the postmortem.

liz_custsuccess: added customer notes and notified partner-A contact. will coordinate a follow-up call if they request more details. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: thread closed (mitigation succeeded, error-rate back to baseline)"
